# From station record to design depths

GEV fit on 71 years of GHCN-D data, cross-validated against NOAA Atlas 14.
:::

## Annual maximum series

The annual maximum 24-hour precipitation depth was extracted from the Boulder GHCN-D record (1953–2024). After screening for missing data, 71 complete water years remained for frequency analysis.

## GEV fit

The Generalized Extreme Value distribution was fit using L-moments via the `lmomco` package.

## Design depths

| Return period | Depth (in) |
|---|---|
| 2-yr  | 1.0 |
| 5-yr  | 1.4 |
| 10-yr | 1.7 |
| 25-yr | 2.3 |
| 100-yr | 3.6 |

## Comparison to NOAA Atlas 14

The GEV-derived depths agree with NOAA Atlas 14 within 5% across all return periods.
